source: Retained official Gpg4win source archive plus official NSIS MultiUser source

findings: The retained Gpg4win 5.1.1 installer source comments that user-mode installation is supported, though system-wide installation is preferred.
The source defines MULTIUSER_EXECUTIONLEVEL Highest and MULTIUSER_INSTALLMODE_COMMANDLINE, then includes MultiUser.nsh. This enables command-line install-mode selection in the built outer installer.
The NSIS MultiUser implementation checks the /CurrentUser argument when MULTIUSER_INSTALLMODE_COMMANDLINE is defined and calls MultiUser.InstallMode.CurrentUser.
The current-user branch sets the install mode to CurrentUser and uses current-user shell context.

outcome.catalogSwitch: /CurrentUser is supported by the MultiUser command-line mode configured by the retained Gpg4win 5.1.1 installer source.
unresolved: This source check does not reproduce the installer build dependency version or prove runtime behavior on the Windows target.
The prior Windows 11 limited-user exit 0xC0000005 remains unexplained.
Actual installer invocation, nested GnuPG current-user scope, component selection, repeat/remove, and exact user-data recovery remain pending disposable-VM acceptance.

resolved: Static source support for the catalog /CurrentUser switch is confirmed.
partial: Gpg4win 5.1.1 current-user package candidate and mocked lifecycle remain partial pending Windows runtime acceptance.
